description: Buy prepaid credits to keep using every tool after the free trial (20 free calls a day). Returns an API key and the exact USDC amount and address to send (Base or Solana); credits arrive ~15 minutes after the transfer. The result gives the new server URL to use (it carries your key). Free to call.

amountUsd.description: Dollars of credit to buy (1-500). Default 5.

network.description: Where you'll send USDC from. Default base.

name: topup
title: Top up credits (free to call)
